risks.title: Economic and market risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's financial performance is highly dependent on market conditions, business climate and investor confidence. Economic slowdowns, geopolitical crises and unfavorable market conditions can significantly impact operations and results.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations directly affect net interest margin and profitability. The net interest margin decreased from 3.58% to 3.51% between 2024 and 2025, reflecting the bank's sensitivity to interest rates.

risks.title: Credit risk and asset quality
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to payment default risk, particularly in the commercial real estate segment which represents 27% of the loan portfolio. Non-performing assets increased from 0.65% to 0.69% of total assets, and net credit provisions rose.

risks.title: Commercial real estate exposure risk
risks.score_rationale: 27% of the loan portfolio is exposed to the commercial real estate market, with net charge-offs of $55.5 million in 2025 and an increase in foreclosed assets (5 commercial properties).

risks.title: Liquidity risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain sufficient liquidity to meet its obligations and customer needs. Deposits increased by 16.3% to $77.2 billion, strengthening the liquidity position.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: Banks are subject to strict and evolving regulations. The company must maintain capital ratios and comply with increasingly stringent prudential standards.

risks.title: Reputation and litigation risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces ordinary litigation and one major lawsuit involving fraud allegations (Cantor Group V, LLC) with an exposure of $98.5 million despite established provisions.

risks.title: Geographic concentration risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is headquartered in Arizona and primarily operates in the southwestern United States. It is exposed to region-specific natural risks (earthquakes, droughts, wildfires).
